## New in this release

### New
- **Accessibility** menu (on the login screen, top right, and in the menu):
  - High contrast: black on white or white on black; the whole app becomes black and white, lessons are outlined (thicker for substitutions and exams).
  - Open the timetable on today's day view instead of the week.
  - Larger day headers; the day view spells out the weekday and date.
  - Text size: five steps from 85 % to 150 %, on top of your device's text size.
  - Loudspeaker button in the timetable that reads the day aloud ("First lesson: Maths with … in room …") with your device's voice. The voice language (English or German) is set separately from the app.

### Fixed
- Read aloud now says the lesson numbers ("first lesson", "second and third lesson") instead of times. If the school sends no usable lesson numbers, they are counted from the day's lessons.
- Lesson details no longer show a made-up lesson number when the school sends no time grid.
- Office hours: teachers who share a last name (when the school sends no first names) are no longer merged into one person.

### Improved
- Office hours can now be searched by teacher or room.
- Search fields (Browse timetables, office hours, subject colors) are easier to spot: a filled, rounded bar with a clear button.

### Behind the scenes
- Screenshots on the GitHub page, generated from the demo data.
